title: Show closed order items as Done and drop them from the order in the refresh
goal: Show closed order items as Done and drop them from the order in the refresh
acceptance: An order item in its repository's archive or closed in its work-item data shows ✅ Done with where it closed, and is no problem
The refresh drops Done items from docs/solution-order.md and renumbers; the workflow commits the order with the views
An ID in neither the active backlog nor the archive still fails the refresh
A Refresh solution views run on main succeeds
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
validation: Test: test/solution-overview.test.mjs (closed order items), test/refresh-branch.test.mjs (order conflict); check:fast; a Refresh solution views run
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: archive lookup, order pruning and workflow change with fixtures. Not a measurement.
